findings.headline: Of 60,142 CVEs published in 2026, only 146 (0.24%) are on CISA's KEV list so far
findings.detail: A floor that rises as the cohort ages, not a final rate. Confirmed exploitation stays rare while volume climbs, the whole triage story.

findings.headline: 2026 year-to-date (60,142) already exceeds every full year before 2026
findings.detail: Six-plus months of 2026 outrank all of 2025 (48,153) and every year prior.

findings.headline: August 2026 was the busiest CVE month ever: 12,269
findings.detail: No calendar month in the program's history published more CVEs.

findings.headline: Only 75 of 2026's 60,142 CVEs (0.12%) score EPSS >= 0.5
findings.detail: 308 (0.5%) clear EPSS 0.1. Predicted exploitation is as rare as confirmed: model v2026.06.15.

findings.headline: Newest CISA KEV entry: CVE-2026-19490 (Citrix NetScaler), added Sep 09
findings.detail: The most recent confirmed-exploited CVE. Timely by definition.

findings.headline: CVE-2026-43284 has the highest EPSS of 2026 not on KEV: 0.932
findings.detail: linux / linux_kernel. High predicted risk the confirmed list hasn't caught up to.

findings.headline: microsoft published 492 more CVEs this month than last
findings.detail: A sharp month-over-month surge worth a closer look.

findings.headline: CISA added 41 CVEs to KEV in the last 30 days, 0 ransomware-linked
findings.detail: Exploitation news travels; a fresh KEV batch is always timely.

findings.headline: chrome disclosed 21 CVEs in one day (2026-09-02)
findings.detail: A single-day mass disclosure. Verify against the vendor's release notes before posting.

findings.headline: GitHub_M is 2026's top CVE issuer with 9,602 (16% of all published)
findings.detail: The CNA mix reflects who has scope, not who ships the worst code.

findings.headline: 60,142 CVEs published so far in 2026, one every 6.0 minutes
findings.detail: 240/day, +87% vs 2025 at the same point. Straight-line run-rate lands near 87,500 for the full year.

findings.headline: The CVE catalog is at 369,015, 985 short of 370,000
findings.detail: At the current rate it crosses 370,000 in about 4 days.

findings.headline: The single biggest CVE day of 2026: 2026-07-21 with 1,474
findings.detail: Batch publishing by high-volume CNAs drives these spikes.

findings.headline: The busiest CVE weekday in 2026 is Tuesday
findings.detail: Tuesday: 14,503 vs Wednesday: 11,676. The 'Patch Tuesday' mental model does not match the data.
